entries.title: Psalms 18:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song on the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. And he said:>> I will love You, O LORD, my strength.

entries.title: Psalms 18:2
segments: The LORD is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer; My God, my strength, in whom I will trust; My shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

entries.title: Psalms 18:3
segments: I will call upon the LORD, [who is worthy] to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 18:4
segments: The pangs of death surrounded me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

entries.title: Psalms 18:5
segments: The sorrows of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:6
segments: In my distress I called upon the LORD, And cried out to my God; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry came before Him, [even] to His ears.

entries.title: Psalms 18:7
segments: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of the hills also quaked and were shaken, Because He was angry.

entries.title: Psalms 18:8
segments: Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire from His mouth; Coals were kindled by it.

entries.title: Psalms 18:9
segments: He bowed the heavens also, and came down With darkness under His feet.

entries.title: Psalms 18:10
segments: And He rode upon a cherub, and flew; He flew upon the wings of the wind.

entries.title: Psalms 18:11
segments: He made darkness His secret place; His canopy around Him [was] dark waters [And] thick clouds of the skies.

entries.title: Psalms 18:12
segments: From the brightness before Him, His thick clouds passed with hailstones and coals of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 18:13
segments: The LORD thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 18:14
segments: He sent out His arrows and scattered the foe, Lightnings in abundance, and He vanquished them.

entries.title: Psalms 18:15
segments: Then the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered At Your rebuke, O LORD, At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.

entries.title: Psalms 18:16
segments: He sent from above, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.

entries.title: Psalms 18:17
segments: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me, For they were too strong for me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:18
segments: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But the LORD was my support.

entries.title: Psalms 18:19
segments: He also brought me out into a broad place; He delivered me because He delighted in me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:20
segments: ¶The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:21
segments: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, And have not wickedly departed from my God.

entries.title: Psalms 18:22
segments: For all His judgments [were] before me, And I did not put away His statutes from me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:23
segments: I was also blameless before Him, And I kept myself from my iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 18:24
segments: Therefore the LORD has recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.

entries.title: Psalms 18:25
segments: With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful; With a blameless man You will show Yourself blameless;

entries.title: Psalms 18:26
segments: With the pure You will show Yourself pure; And with the devious You will show Yourself shrewd.

entries.title: Psalms 18:27
segments: For You will save the humble people, But will bring down haughty looks.

entries.title: Psalms 18:28
segments: For You will light my lamp; The LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

entries.title: Psalms 18:29
segments: ¶For by You I can run against a troop, By my God I can leap over a wall.

entries.title: Psalms 18:30
segments: [As for] God, His way [is] perfect; The word of the LORD is proven; He [is] a shield to all who trust in Him.

entries.title: Psalms 18:31
segments: For who [is] God, except the LORD? And who [is] a rock, except our God?

entries.title: Psalms 18:32
segments: [It is] God who arms me with strength, And makes my way perfect.

entries.title: Psalms 18:33
segments: He makes my feet like the [feet of] deer, And sets me on my high places.

entries.title: Psalms 18:34
segments: He teaches my hands to make war, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

entries.title: Psalms 18:35
segments: You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; Your right hand has held me up, Your gentleness has made me great.

entries.title: Psalms 18:36
segments: You enlarged my path under me, So my feet did not slip.

entries.title: Psalms 18:37
segments: I have pursued my enemies and overtaken them; Neither did I turn back again till they were destroyed.

entries.title: Psalms 18:38
segments: I have wounded them, So that they could not rise; They have fallen under my feet.

entries.title: Psalms 18:39
segments: For You have armed me with strength for the battle; You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:40
segments: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, So that I destroyed those who hated me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:41
segments: They cried out, but [there was] none to save; [Even] to the LORD, but He did not answer them.

entries.title: Psalms 18:42
segments: Then I beat them as fine as the dust before the wind; I cast them out like dirt in the streets.

entries.title: Psalms 18:43
segments: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; You have made me the head of the nations; A people I have not known shall serve me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:44
segments: As soon as they hear of me they obey me; The foreigners submit to me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:45
segments: The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their hideouts.

entries.title: Psalms 18:46
segments: The LORD lives! Blessed [be] my Rock! Let the God of my salvation be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 18:47
segments: [It is] God who avenges me, And subdues the peoples under me;

entries.title: Psalms 18:48
segments: He delivers me from my enemies. You also lift me up above those who rise against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.

entries.title: Psalms 18:49
segments: Therefore I will give thanks to You, O LORD, among the Gentiles, And sing praises to Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 18:50
segments: Great deliverance He gives to His king, And shows mercy to His anointed, To David and his descendants forevermore.
